name: Lakeside Recreational Park
note: Small private park on a 12-acre lake east of Assaria: 20 RV sites, full hookups (water, sewer, electric up to 50-amp) $40 a night; sandy swimming beach. A weekender membership is offered for longer stays. RV Life 4*/$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: lakesiderec.org reservations page (full hookups up to 50-amp, $40 per night, read 2026-10-03); RV Life 4* $ over 22, Google 'Lakeside Family Resort' 4.2 over 44 with phone (read 2026-10-02); membership is for long-term stays only, nightly open to the public (AWH 2026-10-03)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.6512,-97.5930: RV pads on the ring road along the lake's NW corner look across an open sandy day-use beach to the water ~40 m off; the rest of the loop is under canopy behind it; the beach is a used strip, so default down - lakeview
